topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: I stood there, the letter from the school in my hand, the room around me seeming to shift slightly. The same name, the same familiar script. Mrs. Harper. The very teacher who had shaped so much of my own early days, now poised to do the same for my child. It felt like a thread, thin and almost invisible, looping through time, binding past and present in a way I hadn’t anticipated. I traced my fingers over the edge of the paper, the weight of the coincidence settling in. There was a quiet resonance in it, a silent echo that rang true. I knew, then, that this wasn't just a coincidence, but a reminder of something deeper, something worth cherishing.
